description: How far along am I in a program at a school I am considering? One checklist at any target school, chosen by its name or title (or its checklist_id), line by line against what a person holds. Each held item is compared through comparable_map - every source, published and inferred - and each landing joined to the checklist's lines; a GoldRibbon package, when given, adds the lines its prior learning may meet. Each line is met (a published rule lands a held item on it), reached_by_inference (only an inferred landing reaches it: shown with its path of published links, never counted as met), may_be_met_by_prior_learning, or open, with every way it is reached. Each group gives its lines by state beside the choice rule it prints. Last, what does not count: each held item that reaches no line, with its reason (no rule, below the score, or landing on a course this checklist does not require). A case to show the school, not a verdict; recognition is the school's act. Each row names its current FORM's wording source: source_url, capture_file, catalog_year and source_catalog_name are that one source's, never the record's whole span. A row whose record holds more than one form or more than one source also carries version_count, source_count, first_edition_seen and last_edition_seen, and one sentence saying so in words; a record with one form and one source carries none of them and reads exactly as it always has. The forms themselves, each with its own content and its own sources, come from the one-record get, never from a list. A record last seen in an older edition says so, because the Union keeps a record no current catalog prints.

carried.description: Set by `continue.arguments`: the map's progress so far, sent back unchanged

checklist.description: The checklist's name or title at the target (its award title), e.g. Nursing BSN; several fitting are listed, never guessed

checklist_id.description: Or the checklist's id, from find_checklists

held.description: 0 to 20 things held, each as comparable_map takes one: a course { unitid, code }, an exam { program, exam, score }, { learning_unit_id } or { certification_ctid }. Compared 5 per call: an answer with more to compare carries `continue.arguments` to send back as they are

held_offset.description: Set by `continue.arguments`: the held item to start this call's 5 from

package.description: Optional: the person's GoldRibbon package; its prior learning is read on the first call for the lines it may meet

target_unitid.description: The school whose checklist is mapped, by IPEDS UNITID, e.g. 240727

name: checklist_map

candidates.description: When the name fits several checklists, or none

complete.description: true when every held item is compared

continue.description: When more held items remain: compared_through, of, and the arguments for the next call (the next 5, with the progress carried)

credits.description: The lines' printed credits, summed by state, each its own

does_not_count.description: Each held item that reaches no line: item, reason, statement

groups.description: Each group: its lines by state, and the choice rule it prints

lines.description: Every line: its group, code, title, state and reached_by (each way: how, held item, lands_as, band, rule or path, rests_on, minimum_grade, also_needs)

title: Checklist Map
